motion_specs.topology_pulse: SVG lines with animated stroke-dashoffset to simulate data flowing between nodes.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Use exact brand color tokens. Never use Tailwind's default slate/gray; construct custom gradients using background_2 to panel colors. Ensure all charts and graphs use JetBrains Mono for data points. Ensure data-testid attributes are present on every interactive and key informational element. All animations must respect prefers-reduced-motion. SVG charts must use the signal tokens (mint, warn, danger) for stroke colors. Create custom Shadcn components if necessary to achieve the glassmorphic, 1px border aesthetic without generic card padding.
